subject: smartphone apps
title: The 5 Fastest Apps to 100 Million Users, Ranked (#1 Took 5 Days)

scenes.text: ChatGPT's growth shocked the whole tech world. It's only number two.
Number five: Instagram. About two and a half years to reach 100 million users.
scenes.label: Instagram · 2.5 years

scenes.text: Number four: WeChat. About fourteen months for China's messaging app that does almost everything.
scenes.label: WeChat · 14 months

scenes.text: Number three: TikTok. Just nine months after its global launch, from zero to 100 million.
scenes.label: TikTok · 9 months

scenes.text: Number two: ChatGPT. Two months, a record that lasted only about half a year.
scenes.label: ChatGPT · 2 months

scenes.text: Number one: Threads. 100 million sign-ups in five days, riding on Instagram accounts.
scenes.label: Threads · 5 days

description:
How long popular apps took to reach 100 million users: Instagram about 2.5 years (counts range from 2 years 4 months to 2 years 6 months), WeChat about 14 months, TikTok 9 months after its global launch, ChatGPT 2 months, Threads 5 days.
Threads counted sign-ups, helped by one-tap Instagram logins, while ChatGPT's figure was an estimate of monthly active users by UBS analysts.
Which of these do you think will still be around in twenty years?
first_comment: Which app would you have put at number one? And what tech record should we rank next?
